english.title: Contravene an interim condition / a condition in a warning notice / final notice confirming a decision notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), contravened

(A)_[an interim condition in a warning notice given under section 189(4)(b)(i)]_
(B)_[a condition in a decision notice given under section 189(7)]_
(C)_[a final notice which confirmed a decision notice under section 189]_

of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 in that **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 191F(3) and (8) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 401 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that proceedings for offences may be instituted in England and Wales only by the 'appropriate regulator' (either the Financial Conduct or the Prudential Regulation Authority) or the Secretary of State or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.
(ii) For the purpose of this offence, the appropriate regulator means -
(a) where the UK authorised person is a PRA-authorised person, the Prudential Regulation Authority;
(b) in any other case, the Financial Conduct Authority.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Torri amod interim / amod mewn hysbysiad rhybuddio / hysbysiad terfynol yn cadarnhau hysbysiad o benderfyniad

(B)_[amod mewn hysbysiad o benderfyniad o dan adran 189(7)]_
(C)_[hysbysiad terfynol a oedd yn cadarnhau hysbysiad o benderfyniad o dan adran 189]_

welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 191F(3) ac (8) Deddf Marchnadoedd a Gwasanaethau Ariannol 2000.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Eitherway: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
